scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
scripts.backend: cd backend && python3 -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt && python3 -m uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.frontend: cd frontend && npm install --silent && npm run dev
